household.title: Choose your household and places

data.create_zone: Create a new home or place zone
data.create_person: Create a new Home Assistant Person

data_description.pets: Select existing device trackers for pets without Home Assistant Person records. This is a role you assign; the picker can also show people devices. Select each tracker in only one list. The tracker remains this pet’s location source.
data_description.people_trackers: Select existing device trackers for people without Home Assistant Person records. This is a role you assign; the picker can also show pet devices. Select each tracker in only one list. A connected Life360 tracker can be chosen here after it appears.
data_description.life360_direct: Optional. HomeCircle will connect to Life360 itself and create device trackers in Home Assistant. Turn this off after replacing any selected HomeCircle-owned Life360 trackers.
data_description.replace_life360_login: Use this if the password or token changed for the same Life360 account. Existing member selections are kept.
data_description.places: Examples: work, school, or a favorite park. These zones label a location but do not count as Home. Add a dorm or second home under Other homes for the appropriate member.
data_description.create_zone: Open a map to create a missing Home Assistant zone, then return here with your selections intact.
data_description.create_person: Creates an editable Person in Home Assistant; the Person remains there if you later cancel HomeCircle setup.
data_description.family_refresh_enabled: Off by default. Allows an explicit family button to use the existing external Life360 integration’s saved account connection for an unofficial Circle-wide request. Only a complete selected Circle with one enabled account is supported. Household viewers with control permission for every target can request reports; this does not guarantee new GPS fixes. No credentials are sent to the card.

member.title: Choose trackers and places

data.configure_sensors: Set up battery and motion sensors
data.show_on_map: Show this member on the map
data.auto_request_location: Request a location when this member’s phone is quiet

data_description.trackers: Select a tracker you own. Home Assistant Person remains the position source while it has a usable location; a selected GPS tracker can supplement it when needed. Changing this selection does not change the trackers linked to the HA Person.
data_description.additional_residences: These zones also count as Home for this member. The Home map button still focuses the primary family home.
data_description.kind: Choose Pet for a pet record. Pet timing can be adjusted when needed; this does not create a tracker.
data_description.configure_reports: Choose a genuine location report-time sensor separately for each selected source. Leave off if none is available.
data_description.configure_sensors: Choose optional battery, charging, speed and driving sensors on the next screen.
data_description.configure_timing: Only for pets. Keep the current timing when the defaults are right.
data_description.show_on_map: Turn off to leave this member out of the Everyone map and its fit. Selecting the member or a status category still shows their map position.
data_description.auto_request_location: For a selected Home Assistant phone tracker, ask for a location after 15 quiet minutes. Automatic attempts are at least 15 minutes apart and pause after three unanswered attempts until the tracker reports again. Deliberate requests keep a one-minute cooldown. All attempts share the 50-per-24-hour limit. Off by default.
data_description.create_zone: Create a Home Assistant zone on a map and select it for this member without losing the choices above.

confirm.title: Review and save household

confirm_remove.title: Review tracker removal

supporting.title: Status sensors
supporting.description: For {person}, choose only sensors that describe this member. Leave unavailable values empty. Location report times are configured separately for each source.

data_description.battery: Select a sensor with a numeric percentage and % unit.
data_description.charging: Select a binary sensor that says whether this member’s device is charging.
data_description.speed: Select a speed sensor in m/s, km/h or mph.
data_description.driving: Optional. If empty, HomeCircle reads the selected GPS tracker's driving flag. A fresh location report is required to show Driving. A selected binary sensor takes priority.
data_description.driving_reported_at: For a selected driving sensor, choose its actual report time. The tracker fallback uses the tracker's location report time.

source_report.title: Location report time
source_report.description: Source {number} of {total}: {source}. {purpose}. Choose a sensor with the actual time this source reported its location. Leave empty if unknown or to clear an old mapping. Home Assistant state updates are not GPS report times.

pet_freshness.title: Pet location timing
pet_freshness.description: For {person}, choose when a pet location report should be labeled stale. These limits do not change Home/Away status or request a new location.

data.pet_home_minutes: At home: mark location stale after

data_description.pet_home_minutes: Default: 24 hours. Applies at the primary home and this pet’s other homes.
data_description.pet_away_minutes: Default: 5 minutes. Applies when this pet is away from its homes.

life360_account.title: Connect Life360
life360_account.description: Enter a Life360 email and password, or an access token. Some accounts with verified phone numbers cannot use password sign-in. Credentials are saved in Home Assistant configuration storage. Home Assistant Recorder may keep a history of the new tracker locations; review its settings before connecting. Member trackers may take several minutes to appear; reopen HomeCircle Options to select them.

data.confirm_same_account: I confirm this is the same Life360 account

data_description.secret: For access token, enter only the token value. HomeCircle uses Bearer authorization.
data_description.confirm_same_account: Only needed if HomeCircle cannot verify the previously saved sign-in for this older setup.
data_description.username: Required when using email and password. Leave empty for access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Life360
reauth_confirm.description: Life360 rejected the saved sign-in. Enter a current password or access token for the same account. HomeCircle will keep your household and tracker selections.

data.confirm_same_account: I confirm this is the same Life360 account

data_description.secret: For access token, enter only the token value.
data_description.confirm_same_account: The old sign-in may have expired, so HomeCircle may need your confirmation that these credentials belong to the same account.

no_report_sources.title: No report-time source to set up
no_report_sources.description: This member has no current map source or selected tracker that can provide a location report time. Continue without a mapping. You can edit this member later when a tracker is available.

create_zone.title: Create a Home Assistant zone
create_zone.description: Name the zone and place its center on the map. Set the radius to cover the location. Primary home counts as Home for everyone; another home can be selected for a member; an Away place only labels a location.

data_description.use: Choose Primary family home, Another home for a member, or Place shown while Away. When adding another home from this screen, select it on the member screen.
data_description.location: Move the pin to the actual location and choose a radius in meters.
data_description.name: Use a clear name such as School or Second Home.

create_person.title: Create a Home Assistant Person
create_person.description: Enter the member’s name. HomeCircle creates an editable Home Assistant Person, then returns to your selections so you can assign a tracker. A created Person remains in Home Assistant if you cancel this setup.

assign_tracker.title: Assign a tracker to {person}
assign_tracker.description: Choose the device tracker for {person}. HomeCircle will link it to this Home Assistant Person when you save the household. Next you can configure the member’s type, homes, map visibility, battery and report-time sensors. {tracker_guidance}
